text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Online, Shinko Windy was treated as 
nothing more than a meme. To prove them 
wrong, she decided to focus on the 
training camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Biko Pegasus seemed downcast, 
weighed down by a continuing losing 
streak. Seeing this, Shinko Windy...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
He plays a prank. Thanks to this, Biko 
Pegasus perks up and realizes that Shinko 
Windy isn't actually a bad guy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Dirt Derby also lay ahead during 
the training camp. A scorching summer was 
about to begin.
